description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'CursoController' responsible for handling web requests related to 'Curso' (course) entities. It includes mappings for creating, reading, updating, and deleting courses, as well as managing their details and associating courses with professors and users.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing CRUD operations and views for 'Curso' entities including role-based security annotations.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to display form for adding a new course for a specific professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new course associated with a professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve existing course data for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing course with new data.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to delete a specified course.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET request to view detailed information about a course including user enrollment status.
